name: Vampire Lord Berserker

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.details: The vampire lord berserker regains 15 hit points whenever it starts its turn and has at least 1 hit point. Its regeneration does not function while the berserker is exposed to direct sunlight.

effect.description: The berserker uses flaming broadsword twice. If both attacks hit the same target, the target is also dazed (save ends).

failedSavingThrows.name: AverageDamage
failedSavingThrows.description: The target is also weakened (save ends).

powers.name: Blood Drain
powers.usageDetails: when an adjacent living creature becomes bloodied

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature granting combat advantage to the berserker

hit.description: damage, the target is weakened (save ends), and the berserker regains 147 hit points.

effect.description: The berserker becomes insubstantial and gains a fly speed of 12, but cannot make attacks. It can remain in mist form for up to 1 hour or end the effect as a minor action.

powers.name: Dominating Gaze
powers.requirements: The berserker must not be dominating a creature.

hit.description: The target is dominated (save ends; the target takes a -2 penalty to the saving throw).

effect.description: The berserker chooses one allied devil of a lower level than the berserker within 10 squares and slides that devil 5 squares. At the end of that movement, the devil explodes in a close burst 2, destroying itself. Each creature in the burst takes 2d10 + 5 fire damage.
The berserker uses flaming broadsword against a random target adjacent to it as a free action.
